out.subject: Alloy surcharge and base price – volume-based contract proposal
out.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your offer and the explanation of the market movements. I appreciate the continuity of supply from your inventory. Rather than carry the annual increases straight into the new price, I would like to review the calculation against a binding volume and a longer contract.

Our proposed packages commit to 94800 kg per year throughout a 24-month term, with the same annual quantity in each year. Our purchase-order history supports the running business; see the figures below. Which discount tier in your price list does this commitment qualify for?

We propose 90 days net and an AS-14404 index clause. The packages are EUR 5.31 per kg with a 5% deadband, EUR 5.27 per kg with a 3% deadband, or EUR 5.20 per kg without a deadband. Each package has the same volume commitment, payment terms and contract duration.

Please let us know which package best fits your calculation and explain how the volume discount is reflected. That would give us a concrete basis for agreeing the base price and alloy mechanism together.

Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing
out.rationale: Present a binding annual-volume commitment supported by purchase-order history and request the applicable discount tier. Offer index-linked packages with differing deadbands, keeping payment terms and duration consistent, while acknowledging the supplier's market explanation.

out.subject: Revised base price and volume commitment
out.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for recognising the dedicated volume tier and agreeing to the AS-14404 clause. To answer your volume question precisely: our packages commit to 94800 kg per year throughout the 24-month term. We are not proposing a higher annual quantity.

I note your request for 30 days net, but also your indexed offer retaining 90 days net. We would like to continue on the latter basis.

You cite PPI-C2431 as a main cost driver. Please also take its recent movement into account when reviewing the base price; see the figures below. How is the dedicated volume discount reflected in your revised calculation?

We have raised our proposed prices: EUR 5.37 per kg with a 5% deadband, EUR 5.32 per kg with a 3% deadband, or EUR 5.25 per kg without a deadband. All packages retain the AS-14404 clause, 90 days net and the 24-month term, with the annual commitment stated above.

Please review these revised packages against your volume tier and let us know which structure you can support.

Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing
out.rationale: Answers the volume question precisely, acknowledges both payment positions, raises each proposed price, and introduces the PPI-C2431 evidence while retaining the agreed index structure.

out.subject: Revised package for 1.4404 bar
out.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for incorporating the verified PPI movement and confirming that the dedicated volume discount is fully reflected. I also appreciate your retaining 90 days net and the AS-14404 clause without a deadband. I understand that you do not share further calculation details.

To answer your volume question: our proposed package commits to 94800 kg per year throughout the 24-month contract. We are not offering a higher annual quantity. Thank you for offering your wider range; this enquiry remains limited to the bar material discussed.

We can move our proposal to EUR 5.35 per kg, with 90 days net and a 24-month term. The AS-14404 clause would have no deadband, a material share of 45% and base month 2026-08.

This keeps the structure you have proposed and makes a further price concession on our side. Please put this package to your management for review against the dedicated volume tier. Can you support it on that basis?

Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

out.subject: Re: Bar material – revised indexed package
out.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for reviewing the package with your management and reducing your offer to EUR 5.38 per kg while retaining the payment terms and contract duration.

To answer your questions: our price proposal was based on the purchase-order history and public PPI movement already supplied and verified by you, together with the dedicated volume tier. It was not a reconstruction of your calculation. For completeness, I am also sending your supplier scorecard data below.

Our proposed package commits to 94800 kg per year throughout the 24-month term. We are not proposing a higher annual quantity.

Rather than repeat our previous price request, we propose EUR 5.42 per kg with a 3% deadband in the AS-14404 clause, retaining its 45% material share and base month 2026-08, together with 90 days net and the 24-month contract.

This raises the price we would pay in exchange for a deadband that avoids adjustments for smaller index movements. Can your management support this revised balance of price and index protection?

Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing
out.rationale: Offer a higher unit price in exchange for index protection, preserving the accepted payment and contract structure. Answer the volume and data questions and provide the supplier's scorecard as additional supporting data.
